faq.q: What can image to video do with a product photo?
faq.a: It turns a still into a short video. For sellers, the teal bottle photo can become a clip with motion, a voiceover, and captions you can post.

faq.q: How does a photo become a video?
faq.a: Upload the image and describe the motion you want. Add a script and a voiceover, plus on-screen text, and review the clip before you post it.

faq.q: What do you gain by making video from a photo?
faq.a: More ads from the photos you already own. You skip the shoot, and you can make another version whenever the current one goes stale. A 6-second clip is 24 credits.

faq.q: Can I post these clips on social?
faq.a: Yes. Size each clip for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts, and post it as an ad or as a regular unpaid post.

faq.q: How can a store use this for product marketing?
faq.a: Show the product in action, reveal a before-and-after, run social video ads, or add a video to your Amazon listing. Each one starts from the same photo.

faq.q: Can I make explainers and tutorials?
faq.a: Yes. Keep one AI avatar and one script style for every lesson, so feature walkthroughs and training clips look consistent without re-recording.

faq.q: Can I add a voiceover or an AI avatar?
faq.a: Yes. Write your own script or let the tool draft one, pick a voice, and add an AI avatar to present the product on camera.

faq.q: Which aspect ratios can I pick?
faq.a: Choose 9:16 for TikTok, Reels, and Stories, 1:1 for the feed, or 16:9 for YouTube. 4:3 and 3:4 are there too.
